from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """The core case information extracted from one document."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The official title of the legal document")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="The general nature of the case (e.g., 'Administrative', 'Civil', 'Criminal', 'Execution')")
    dispute_subject: str = Field(description="The primary subject matter of the dispute (e.g., 'Land Right', 'Patent', 'Execution Objection', 'Bribery')")
    legal_action: str = Field(description="The specific legal action or administrative act involved (e.g., 'Forced Demolition', 'Property Recovery', 'Reconsideration')")
    key_parties: list[str] = Field(description="Key entities involved (e.g., 'Citizen', 'Government Bureau', 'Company')")
    summary: str = Field(description="A brief summary of the core facts and court's finding")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[DocumentCase]
